title: State/Local data sharing of CAD/RMS/JMS records with interstate/private entities

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Montana Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any data-sharing, access, or memorandum of understanding agreements governing access to or disclosure of data in the Montana Incident-Based Reporting System (MTIBRS) or the Criminal Justice Data Warehouse created under Senate Bill 11 (2023), including the MOU with Ravalli County or any other participating county.
2. The contract, amendments, and order forms with CentralSquare Technologies for the Data Warehouse API component, and the contract for the MTIBRS repository system.
3. Any agreement under which a private company, researcher, or federal agency other than the FBI received record-level data from MTIBRS or the Data Warehouse.
Time range: January 1, 2020 through the date of fulfillment.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal

title: MT DOJ - Interstate data sharing of RMS/CAD/JMS data

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Montana Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Any current contract, subscription agreement, order form, or memorandum of understanding between the Montana Department of Justice (including the Division of Criminal Investigation and the Montana Analysis & Technical Information Center) and a private data or analytics vendor that facilitates data sharing. This includes, but is not limited to, LexisNexis Risk Solutions (Accurint for Law Enforcement or the Accurint Virtual Crime Center), SoundThinking's CrimeTracer (previously Shot Spotter and Coplink X), Motorola Solutions or Vigilant Solutions (license plate data), Flock Safety, and Datamaxx (Omnixx).
2. Any agreement under which the Department shares Montana law enforcement data with, or gives access to, a federal agency or a multi-state system, including FBI N-DEx participation and any agreement with the Drug Enforcement Administration about license plate reader data, or local/state CAD, RMS, or JMS data. 
3. Any agreement under which the Department or a Montana agency contributes its own incident, arrest, or booking records to a commercial provider's database (i.e. do you share state level data with LexisNexis, CrimeTracer, or other companies that facilitate police data sharing?).

I'm researching how law enforcement data moves between Montana agencies, private vendors, and federal systems. If it would keep costs down, a list of current agreements (vendor, title, date) would be a useful first step, and I can narrow from there.
Time range: Any active agreements are responsive, regardless of when they were signed - if they remain in effect then please include them. If a search start date is still required, then please use 1/1/2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
